title: One Open Rental Reservation per Repair Order or Warranty Coverage
content:
**Rule.** Under Rental Vehicle Coordination, one insurance claim repair order, customer-pay repair order or warranty coverage may have at most one open reservation, where open means reserved or on rent. No open reservation exists for the same repair order or warranty coverage when a reservation is made. A different class is a class change on the open reservation, never a second reservation.

## Condition for reserving

| Element | Content |
|---|---|
| Applies to | Reserving a replacement rental |
| Condition | No open reservation exists for the same repair order or warranty coverage |
| Evidence | The system's reservation records: the insurance claim repair order, customer-pay repair order or warranty coverage each reservation is for, and each reservation's status |
| Authority | The system record, read before the reservation is made |
| Same object | A reservation counts against the new one only when it is for the same insurance claim repair order, the same customer-pay repair order or the same warranty coverage |

## Which statuses count as open

| Reservation status | Open |
|---|---|
| Reserved | Yes |
| On rent | Yes |
| Returned | No |
| Settled | No |
| Cancelled | No |

## Hypothetical cases

- A customer-pay repair order already carries a reservation that is on rent. That reservation is open, so the condition for reserving again on that repair order is not met; a wish to drive a larger class is a class change on the reservation that is on rent.
- An insurance claim repair order carries only a cancelled reservation. A cancelled reservation is not open, so no open reservation exists for that repair order and the condition is met.
- A warranty coverage carries a reservation that is reserved, and the same customer has a different insurance claim repair order with no reservation. The reservation on the warranty coverage does not count against the claim repair order, which is a different object.
